messages:
marta: Thanks everyone who tuned into todays all-hands. Recording + slides are here: https://redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22. Im collecting follow-ups in this thread — please tag me if I missed your live question.
ajay: Two quick items: 1) EU Dedicated timing? 2) Canary rollback criteria? Need both for a customer reply.
marta: Short notes: EU Dedicated pilot target Q3, GA Q4 (pending infra checks). Canary rollback: automatic if error rate >150% of baseline or p50 latency >2x baseline during the monitoring window. Will post the full playbook link.
sophie: Can we get a one-page network/security checklist for Private? Legal asked for that before we schedule onboarding.
kevin: Ill draft a network topology + checklist (KMS, VPC peering, audit log paths) and drop it in the private-deploy repo. Target: next Tue.
daria: Optimize roadmap question: are batching and cache improvements still top priority for Q2?
marta: Yes, infra + serving keep batching/cache as top-3. Were publishing perf targets in the roadmap doc (link above). Daria, can you own publishing the specifics?
daria: Yep, will put perf targets and expected unit-cost delta in the roadmap doc by EOD two weeks.
olivia: Action for docs/support: we should publish sample unit-cost worksheets (chat vs embeddings) + recommended quant/ batching settings for common workloads.
marta: Good call. Olivia, can you own that with 3 example customers from Solutions Eng?
olivia: On it. Will pull numbers from support and SE, draft a sheet, and add to docs. ETA: 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://storage.redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22/recording.mp4
sam: Also asked live about per-region latency SLOs for Dedicated vs Hosted — sales needs a clear FAQ entry.
marta: Dedicated offers reserved capacity and throughput guarantees; latency SLOs vary by hardware config. Well publish a guidance matrix in Dedicated docs and an FAQ for sales.
kevin: Ill include example numbers for common GPU configs and link to the Dedicated docs. ETA: 1 week.
ajay: For the rollout example in the demo, can we get the exact monitoring dashboard links so customers see what to watch?
marta: Yes. Kevin will add dashboard links to the rollout playbook.

Action items (please reply to claim or adjust):
- kevin: private-deploy topology + security checklist (KMS, audit log paths) — due next Tue
- kevin: rollout playbook dashboard links + explicit thresholds — due in 1 week
- daria: publish batching/cache perf targets and expected unit-cost impact in roadmap doc — due in 2 weeks
- olivia: sample unit-cost worksheets (chat, embeddings) + 3 SE customer examples — due in 2 weeks
- marta: send 30m deep-dive invite on routing/cost controls and paste full rollout playbook link here — due this week

marta: Thanks again. If you posted a question in the live thread and dont see it addressed here, reply or DM me and Ill add it. :thumbsup:
